tagline: VectorCraft on a Selkies web desktop: vector illustration with paths and type, SVG and PDF in and out.
description: VectorCraft, vector illustration in the spirit of Illustrator, SVG and PDF in and out, on a Selkies web desktop. It runs in your browser without a VNC client or a local install, on amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: VectorCraft
